characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model part gains Academy.
Model parts with Academy in the model’s unit gain Artistry of Death.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Attached, Exclusive (Height 1), Frenzy, Fury, Unruly, and War Platform.
Model parts with Elf in friendly units within 12" of the Altar of Nabh gain Fury.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model’s Charge Speed and Mobility are always 0".
In addition, it gains Channel (2), Emplacement, Fearless, Solitary, Stubborn, and Unstable.
When another friendly unit within 18" of the model suffers one or more HP losses from an enemy attack, the Altar of Tila may cause three hits with Str 4, AP 2, and Unmodifiable onto the enemy unit that caused those losses. This effect can only be used once per phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Attached, Exclusive (Height 1), War Platform, and a single Attendant model part gains Petrifying Stare.
Whenever a friendly unit within 12" of the Altar of Yema initiates any kind of move (see the Definition and Terminology chapter in the Reference Handbook), the unit gains +1 Mobility and Devastating Charge (Strider), with Duration: End of Turn.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: Standard Melee Attacks gain +1 to wound.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
Exclusive (Captain, Silent Assassin). The unit’s maximum size is changed to 15 models for units entirely with Height 1, and to 6 models for units entirely with Height 2.
Rank-and-File model parts with Elf in the bearer’s unit gain Devastating Charge (+1 Att).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: At the End of each friendly Status Phase, choose a friendly Beast or Cavalry model within 6" of the model. The chosen model gains Devastating Charge (Hatred) until the end of the Player Turn. In the case of a Cavalry model, only the mount gains the benefit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model part gains Slaver.
Apply the following effects to units within range of this model’s Commanding Presence (friend or foe):
  • Friendly units containing Beast: Courage Tests gain Minimised.
  • Friendly units: rolls for the number of hits from Stomp Attack gain Maximised.
  • Enemy units: rolls for the number of hits from Stomp Attack gain Minimised.

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: End of Combat.
Can be activated at the start of any Round of Combat. One friendly unit entirely with Beast within 12" of the bearer gains Dying Blow.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
A model part with a Breath Attack can use it as a Shooting Weapon in the Shooting Phase or as a Melee Attack in the Melee Phase. If a model has more than one Breath Attack, it can only use one in a single phase.
  • When used as a Shooting Weapon, the attack has a range of 6". It can be used even if the model Marched previously in this Player Turn.
  • When used as a Melee Attack, the attack is made at the model part’s Agility in addition to its normal Close Combat Attacks. Declare that you are using the Breath Attack when allocating attacks, and choose a model in base contact to attack with it. When used in this way, it still counts as firing a shot for the purpose of Slow Reload. No matter if it is used as a Shooting Weapon or Melee Attack, the target of the Breath Attack suffers a single hit. The Strength, Armour Penetration and Attack Attributes (if any) of these hits are given within the brackets of the model rule as X, Y and Z. For example: Breath Attack (Str 4, AP 1, Flaming Attacks, Slow Reload).

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text: While the bearer’s unit is part of a Combined Charge, that unit, as well as all other units that are Charging the same target, must reroll failed Charge Range rolls, and benefit from Devastating Charge (Hard Target (1)).

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The bearer can cast Whispers of the Veil (Evocation) as a Bound Spell (4+).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The unit benefits from Hard Target (1) while in contact with a Water Terrain.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model’s base size is changed to 100×150 mm, the number of its HP is set to 8, and it gains 2 additional Lashmasters.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attacks made by the target suffer −1 AP.
Attacks made against the target gain +1 AP.
Attacks from spells are not affected.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
When a unit containing Daeb Warfare is part of a Combined Charge, its Charge Range rolls gain Maximised.
When multiple units containing Daeb Warfare are Engaged in the same Combined Combat, each of these units gains First Strike (Resolute).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Aegis (5+, against Melee Attacks), Elven Finesse, First Strike (+1 Att), and Weapon Master.
It also gains Great Weapon, Halberd, and Shield.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A Charging model with this Attribute, or using a weapon with this Attribute, gains the Model Rules and Characteristic modifiers stated in brackets (X). For example, a Charging model part with Devastating Charge (+1 Strength, Poison Attacks) gains +1 Strength and Poison Attacks when it is Charging. This rule is cumulative: a model part with several instances of Devastating Charge applies all Attack Attributes and Characteristics modifiers from all of them when Charging.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The Manticore gains Stomp Attack (D3), and its base size is changed to 50×100 mm.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
The bearer’s unit gains Horror.
During Choosing Equipment and Abilities, select one Rank-and-File model part, or a model part on the bearer’s model, in the Front Rank of the bearer’s unit: that model part gains Petrifying Stare, with Duration: Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
During its First Round of Combat, any model part with First Strike, or using a weapon with First Strike, gains the Rules and Characteristic modifiers stated in brackets.
For example, a model part with First Strike (+1 Str) gains +1 Str in its First Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Any unit that suffers one or more hits from this weapon loses Swiftstride, and cannot regain it in any way, until the start of the Active Player’s next Turn.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: During the first Round of Combat, failed to-hit rolls from attacks with Hatred must be rerolled.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
At Initiative Step 10, a Charging model part with Impact Hits must choose an enemy model in base contact. This model suffers a number of hits equal to the value stated in brackets (X). These hits are resolved with the attacking model part’s Strength and Armour Penetration, unless otherwise specified.
If a model has both Grind Attack and Impact Hits, it may only use one of these rules in the same Round of Combat (the owner may choose which).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: When casting a Learned Spell, any Dispelling Roll made against its Casting Roll suffers a −1 modifier.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +1 Armour and Strider (Water Terrain).

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+1 Str, +1 AP.
If the wielder causes one or more HP losses with this weapon, then all attacks made by Rank-and-File models in its unit gain +1 to hit, with Duration: Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Scent of Blood, and treats all friendly models with Beast as Insignificant.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
The bearer gains Aegis (5+, against Melee Attacks). If one or more Melee Attacks are allocated against the bearer, it gains Grind Attack (3, Str 4, AP 2, Magical Attacks, Unmodifiable), with Duration: Round of Combat.
This Grind Attack is always resolved with Agi 0.
(Note that attacks made at Agility Step 0 can trigger this effect.)

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
Health Point losses caused by the attack are multiplied into the value given in brackets (X). If the value is a dice, roll one dice for each unsaved wound from an attack with Multiple Wounds.
The number of Health Point losses that the attack is multiplied into can never be higher than the Health Points Characteristic of the target (excluding Health Points lost previously in the battle).
For example, if an attack with Multiple Wounds (D6) wounds a unit of Trolls (HP 3) and rolls a ‘5’ for the multiplier, the number of Health Points lost is reduced to 3, even if the Troll unit has already lost one or two Health Points previously in battle.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: At the model part’s Agility Step, each enemy unit in contact with it suffers two hits that are set to-wound on 5+, always have AP 10, Magical Attacks and Unmodifiable.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
If the attack hits with a natural to-hit roll of ‘6’, it automatically wounds with no roll to wound needed.
Shooting Attacks using Hopeless Shots wound automatically only if the first to-hit roll is a natural ‘6’. Note that the second to-hit roll must still be successful in order to hit the target.
If the attack can be turned into more than one hit (e.g. a hit with Battle Focus), only a single hit, chosen by the attacker, automatically wounds. All other hits must roll to wound as normal.

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: Accurate, Quick to Fire, Stand and Shoot, Long Range 0 AP

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: Unless the wearer is Shaken, Break Tests and Panic Tests taken by friendly units within 6" of the wearer benefit from Minimised.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Charge Range rolls made by units entirely with Scent of Blood gain Maximised if the target of the Charge contains a Health Pool that has fewer Health Points than its starting value.

characteristics.name: Armour Enchant
characteristics.$text: For each HP loss the wearer inflicts with Standard Melee Attacks on enemy models, it gains +1 Armour, with Duration: Permanent.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: While mounted on an Elven Horse, the model gains March and Shoot and Vanguard (12").

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: A model part with Stomp Attack can make a Special Attack which is resolved at Agility Step 0, can only be allocated towards a Health Pool of Height 0–1, and inflicts X hits, using the model part’s Strength, Armour Penetration and Attack Attributes, but not Weapons. If more than one model part of a combined model has Stomp Attack, only a single model part (chosen by the model’s owner) can perform its Stomp Attack in each Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
When a model with Sweeping Attack is within 1" of an Unengaged enemy unit during a Move Manoeuvre (even temporarily), the model’s unit may perform a Sweeping Attack against that enemy unit. This can only be used once per friendly Player Turn.
Resolve the Sweeping Attack when the Move Manoeuvre is completed. The attack hits automatically, and counts as a Ranged Attack.
Each model part in the unit with Sweeping Attack must use it towards the same enemy unit. The attack causes X hits, resolved with the model part’s Strength, Armour Penetration and Attack Attributes, but not Weapons.
If values for Strength, Armour Penetration and additional Attack Attributes are defined in the bracket (Y), these are used instead. In this case, the Sweeping Attack is Unmodifiable.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The “Dread Acolyte” model part gains Artistry of Death, Paired Weapons and Temple.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text: For each HP loss the wielder inflicts with this weapon on enemy models, it gains +1 Str and +1 AP, up to a maximum of +2 each, with Duration: Permanent.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Enemy units within 8" of one or more Mist Leviathans suffer −1 to hit with Shooting Attacks.
In addition, during the first Game Turn, all models in friendly units containing Height 1 within 8" of one or more Mist Leviathans gain Hard Target (1).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The unit gains \alphaorderlistandbf{\wizardconclave{2}, \irresistiblewill}. \newline The “\dreadacolyte” model part gains \ChTag{\warlock}. \newline The unit selects its spells from: \item \spellformat{\evocationspellone}{\evocation} \item \spellformat{\witchcraftspellthree}{\witchcraft} \item \spellformat{\curseofthephantomqueen}{\hereditaryspell} }

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: An attack with Zeal must reroll failed to-wound rolls.
